environment.description: Same service binary deployed inside a lightweight process namespace with pivot_root(2) into /srv/iot-sandbox/rootfs (minimal busybox-based image). The mount namespace is configured via unshare(1) with --mount --propagation=private before exec. The new root contains only: /var/spool/iot/ (empty, tmpfs, noexec,nosuid,size=50M), /dev/null, /dev/urandom, /proc (hidepid=2). No /etc, /bin, /usr, /home, or any system directories exist within the namespace root. The process also has a seccomp-bpf filter (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on execve, execveat, and mount syscalls). The pivot_root target is bind-mounted read-only except for the single tmpfs at /var/spool/iot/. Process UID inside namespace is mapped to unprivileged host UID 65534 via user namespace.

config.isolation: pivot_root into /srv/iot-sandbox/rootfs with mount namespace (private propagation)
config.mount_flags: rootfs bind-mount is read-only; /var/spool/iot is tmpfs with noexec,nosuid
config.user_namespace: UID 0 inside maps to host UID 65534 (nobody)
